audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags it directly: Gragas wins 57.61% over 184 games, yet the chart handed Cassiopeia 5 of 7 stages and Gragas none, and the page was graded FAV/8.5-difficulty in red. The page's own prose contradicts that — early says level 2 wins the return trade, mid says 'this is where you take over', and spikes[0..2] are all Gragas windows.
audit.why: Gragas takes W at 2 for Drunken Rage's empowered auto plus Happy Hour, out-sustains Noxious Blast poke once W is maxed, and at 6 has a genuine kill on a champion with no dash and no escape. Cassiopeia only owns the 2+ item window.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Cassiopeia across both layers, with matching whys, and the grade moved to EVEN at 4/10 to match the win rate and the mirror's EVEN verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was marked as Cassiopeia's stage and the first-item window as neutral, and no spike text carried real numbers.
audit.why: Level 6 is Gragas's cleanest kill: Cassiopeia has no dash and no escape, so E into Explosive Cask (100s) removes her before Petrifying Gaze resolves. First item plus W damage reduction lets you eat a Miasma tick and still finish the burst before Twin Fang ramps.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and phases[5] now belong to Gragas, and whys[4]/whys[5] state why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Miasma grounds you, so Body Slam will not fire inside it — was described generically and its cooldown was never given.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16 seconds, the longest cooldown in her lane kit, while Noxious Blast is 3.5s and Twin Fang 0.75s. The entire matchup is fighting inside Miasma's downtime; a 24-second gap at rank 1 is a huge, trackable window and it was absent from the page.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block, tldr, winCon and trade lines now name Miasma's 24s and Body Slam's 14s and key the all-in to that downtime.

audit.why: The flagged suspectName 'Barrel Roll's' is a false positive — Barrel Roll is the real name of Gragas's Q.

edits.after: 3 is even — Miasma grounds your Body Slam, but it is 24s, and inside that gap your E-W-Q out-damages her poke.

edits.before: Through 4-5 she keeps poking — your sustain is growing but a grounded Miasma still denies the all-in you need to commit.
edits.after: 4-5 tilt to you — W max and Happy Hour out-sustain her poke, so commit the full E-W-Q every time Miasma is down.

edits.before: Even at your 6 spike she can edge it — a clean Miasma-into-Petrifying-Gaze chain DPS-es you before E-W-Q-Cask connects.
edits.after: 6 is your best window — she has no dash and no escape, so E into Explosive Cask kills before Petrifying Gaze lands.

edits.before: First item she stays ahead on this window — ramping Twin Fang DPS plus poison out-values your single Riftmaker all-in if she kites it.
edits.after: First item is yours — W damage reduction eats a Miasma tick and Riftmaker finishes the burst before her Twin Fang ramps up.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then poke with barrels and slam the Miasma cooldown.
edits.after: She kites you out — punish Miasma's 24s downtime with E-W-Q before her poison ramps.

edits.before: Poke with barrels and slam the Miasma cooldown. Track Miasma before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Fight in Miasma's 24s downtime — without the ground her kit cannot stop you, so E-W-Q her and keep the wave central.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wins by landing Miasma, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Cassiopeia wins by grounding your Body Slam with Miasma, then ramping Twin Fang as she kites.

edits.before: Q-poke Cassiopeia on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Q-poke Cassiopeia from fog angles, W as she answers, and E-slam only while Miasma's 24s cooldown is running.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body-slamming into her Miasma — grounded, your E never fires and you stand in poison for free.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia Miasma: 24s at rank 1 — it grounds you, so your Body Slam will not fire inside it, and that downtime is your whole lane. - Your Body Slam: 14s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip. - Explosive Cask: 100s — kill windows only.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by whether you fight inside Miasma's 24-second downtime.
